definitions.literal:
c1_allowed_fetch xp ordinary a <=>
    xp a /\ ordinary a /\
    (assurance_region (word 0x21001110) 22 a \/
     assurance_region (word 0x21001030) 6 a \/
     assurance_region (word 0x10241840) 95 a)
definitions.name: c1_allowed_fetch

definitions.literal:
c1_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n a <=>
    rp a /\ ordinary a /\
    (assurance_region p n a \/ assurance_region q n a \/
     c1_call_slot stackpointer a \/ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a \/
     assurance_region (word 0x21003fd8) 8 a)
definitions.name: c1_allowed_read

definitions.literal:
c1_allowed_write wp ordinary stackpointer a <=>
    wp a /\ ordinary a /\ c1_call_slot stackpointer a
definitions.name: c1_allowed_write

definitions.literal:
c1_call_slot (stackpointer:int64) a <=>
    assurance_region (word_sub stackpointer (word 16)) 8 a
definitions.name: c1_call_slot
c1_crypto_caller_mc

definitions.literal:
c1_crypto_plt_prefix:byte list =
   [word 0xff;word 0x25;word 0xa2;word 0x2f;word 0x00;word 0x00]
definitions.name: c1_crypto_plt_prefix

definitions.literal:
c1_crypto_ready lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp xp ordinary
    (s:x86state) a (t:x86state) <=>
    bp_e2_crypto_public_pre lib_file (read memory t) (read memory t)
      (word_sub stackpointer (word 16)) (word 0x21001119) p q n
      (read memory t) rp xp ordinary (t,a) /\
    (!addr. ~c1_call_slot stackpointer (val addr)
            ==> read memory t addr=m addr) /\
    (!i. i<n ==> read memory t (word_add p (word i))=m(word_add p (word i))) /\
    (!i. i<n ==> read memory t (word_add q (word i))=m(word_add q (word i))) /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) t=
      read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s /\
    c1_loaded_code t /\ c1_got t /\ c1_prefix_frame stackpointer s t
definitions.name: c1_crypto_ready

definitions.literal:
c1_file_code (file_bytes:num->byte) <=>
    (!i. i<22 ==> file_bytes(0x1110+i)=EL i c1_crypto_caller_mc) /\
    (!i. i<6 ==> file_bytes(0x1030+i)=EL i c1_crypto_plt_prefix)
definitions.name: c1_file_code

definitions.literal:
c1_frame stackpointer =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX;RDI;RSI;RDX;R10;R11] ,,
    MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
    MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes(word_sub stackpointer (word 16),8)] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [events]
definitions.name: c1_frame

definitions.literal:
c1_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding (m:int64->byte) <=>
    !a. c1_image_domain (val a)
        ==> m a = c1_reference_image file_bytes initial_rw padding a
definitions.name: c1_full_image

definitions.literal:
c1_got (s:x86state) <=>
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word 0x21003fd8)) s=word 0x10241840
definitions.name: c1_got

definitions.literal: c1_initialized_rw a <=> 0x21003db0 <= a /\ a < 0x21004010
definitions.name: c1_initialized_rw

definitions.literal:
c1_loaded_code (s:x86state) <=>
    bytes_loaded s (word 0x21001110) c1_crypto_caller_mc /\
    bytes_loaded s (word 0x21001030) c1_crypto_plt_prefix /\
    bytes_loaded s (word 0x10241840) crypto_memcmp_mc
definitions.name: c1_loaded_code

definitions.literal:
c1_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary
    (s:x86state,a:abi_omitted_state) <=>
    n<2 EXP 64 /\ 16<=val(stackpointer:int64) /\
    val stackpointer MOD 16=8 /\ val stackpointer+8<2 EXP 64 /\
    assurance_canonical48(val(ra:int64)) /\ ~(ra=word 0x21001110) /\
    read RIP s=word 0x21001110 /\ read RSP s=stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s=ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p;q;word n] s /\ read memory s=m /\
    read DF s=F /\ ~bit 18(read rflags s) /\ e5_normal_flags s /\
    assurance_canonical48(val(read ABI_FS_BASE a)) /\
    fb_file_code lib_file /\ fb_full_image lib_file lib_rw lib_padding m /\
    c1_file_code client_file /\
    c1_full_image client_file client_rw client_padding m /\
    c1_loaded_code s /\ c1_got s /\
    (!addr. lw_image_domain addr ==>
       rp addr /\ ordinary addr /\ (xp addr <=> lw_execute addr) /\
       (wp addr <=> lw_image_write addr)) /\
    (!addr. c1_image_domain addr ==>
       rp addr /\ ordinary addr /\ (xp addr <=> c1_image_execute addr) /\
       (wp addr <=> c1_image_write addr)) /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val p) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val q) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer-16) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. wp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer-16) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) 0x21003fd8 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 0x21001110 22 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 0x21001030 6 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 0x10241840 95 /\
    (!addr. ~(assurance_region p n addr /\ c1_call_slot stackpointer addr)) /\
    (!addr. ~(assurance_region q n addr /\ c1_call_slot stackpointer addr)) /\
    (!addr. ~(assurance_region stackpointer 8 addr /\
              c1_call_slot stackpointer addr))
definitions.name: c1_pre

definitions.literal:
c1_prefix_frame stackpointer =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP] ,, MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
    MAYCHANGE [memory :> bytes(word_sub stackpointer (word 16),8)] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [events]
definitions.name: c1_prefix_frame

definitions.literal:
c1_public_post stackpointer ra p q n m s a
    (t:x86state#abi_omitted_state) <=>
    c1_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m s (FST t) /\
    SND t=a /\ abi_required_controls_preserved a (SND t)
definitions.name: c1_public_post

definitions.literal:
c1_reference_image (file_bytes:num->byte)
     (initial_rw:int64->byte) (padding:int64->byte) (a:int64) =
    if c1_immutable (val a) then file_bytes (val a - 0x21000000)
    else if c1_initialized_rw (val a) then initial_rw a else padding a
definitions.name: c1_reference_image

definitions.literal:
c1_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m (s:x86state) t <=>
    read RIP t=ra /\ val(read RSP t)=val(stackpointer:int64)+8 /\
    read RAX t=(if (!i. i<n ==> m(word_add p (word i))=
                                  m(word_add q (word i)))
                then word 1 else word 0) /\
    (!addr. ~c1_call_slot stackpointer (val addr)
            ==> read memory t addr=m addr) /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) t=ra /\
    read RBX t=read RBX s /\ read RBP t=read RBP s /\
    read R12 t=read R12 s /\ read R13 t=read R13 s /\
    read R14 t=read R14 s /\ read R15 t=read R15 s /\
    read DF t=F /\ c1_loaded_code t /\ c1_got t /\
    c1_frame stackpointer s t
definitions.name: c1_scalar_post

definitions.literal:
c1_segment_policy stackpointer p q n rp wp xp ordinary
    remaining source target <=>
    assurance_step_policy
      (c1_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n)
      (c1_allowed_write wp ordinary stackpointer)
      (c1_allowed_fetch xp ordinary) source target /\
    abi_all_decodes_caller_scalar source
definitions.name: c1_segment_policy

definitions.literal:
c1_step_policy stackpointer p q n rp wp xp ordinary
    remaining source target <=>
    c1_segment_policy stackpointer p q n rp wp xp ordinary
      remaining source target /\
    (remaining=1 ==> assurance_actual_ret 1 source target)
definitions.name: c1_step_policy

definitions.literal: c1_steps n = 8 + bp_assurance_call_steps n
definitions.name: c1_steps

definitions.literal:
e5_normal_flags (s:x86state) <=>
    ~bit 16 (read rflags s) /\ ~bit 8 (read rflags s)
definitions.name: e5_normal_flags

definitions.literal: e5_rf_clear (s:x86state) = write (rflags :> bitelement 16) F s
definitions.name: e5_rf_clear

definitions.literal:
e5_rf_retired_step (s:x86state) t <=>
    ?u. x86 s u /\ t=e5_rf_clear u
definitions.name: e5_rf_retired_step

definitions.literal:
e5_rf_retired_extended_step (s:x86state,a:abi_omitted_state) t <=>
    ?u b. abi_caller_scalar_extended_step (s,a) (u,b) /\
          t=(e5_rf_clear u,b)
definitions.name: e5_rf_retired_extended_step

definitions.literal:
e5_normal_step_policy (C:num->x86state->x86state->bool) k s t <=>
    C k s t /\ e5_normal_flags s /\ e5_normal_flags t
definitions.name: e5_normal_step_policy

definitions.literal:
e5_normal_environment long_mode cpl (dr7:int64) cet_enabled
      external_event_delivered debug_agent_modified <=>
    long_mode /\ cpl=3 /\
    (!i. i<8 ==> ~bit i dr7) /\ ~cet_enabled /\
    ~external_event_delivered /\ ~debug_agent_modified
definitions.name: e5_normal_environment

definitions.literal:
(e5_rf_checked_run 0 (P:x86state->bool)
      (C:num->x86state->x86state->bool) s <=> P s) /\
  (e5_rf_checked_run (SUC n) P C s <=>
     (?t. e5_rf_retired_step s t) /\
     !t. e5_rf_retired_step s t ==> C (SUC n) s t /\
                                      e5_rf_checked_run n P C t)
definitions.name: e5_rf_checked_run

definitions.literal:
c1_crypto_completed lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp xp ordinary
    (initial:x86state) a (returned:x86state) <=>
    ?entry:x86state.
      c1_crypto_ready lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp xp ordinary initial a entry /\
      bp_assurance_call_post 0x10241840 (word_sub stackpointer (word 16))
        (word 0x21001119) p q n (read events entry) (read memory entry) entry returned
definitions.name: c1_crypto_completed

definitions.literal:
c1_crypto_public_frame =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX;RDI;RSI;RDX;R10;R11] ,,
    MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,, MAYCHANGE [events]
definitions.name: c1_crypto_public_frame

definitions.literal:
c1_entry_witness lib_file client_file p q n k different <=>
    ?lib_rw lib_padding client_rw client_padding m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
      c1_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
        (word 0x300008) (word 0x400000) p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (s,a) /\
      (!i. i<n ==> m(word_add p (word i))=
        (if different /\ i=k then word 255 else word 128)) /\
      (!i. i<n ==> m(word_add q (word i))=word 128) /\
      (p=word 0 /\ q=word 0 /\ n=0 ==> ~rp 0)
definitions.name: c1_entry_witness

definitions.literal:
c1_tail_post stackpointer ra result current (s:x86state) t <=>
    read RIP t=ra /\ val(read RSP t)=val(stackpointer:int64)+8 /\
    read RAX t=(if result=word 0 then word 1 else word 0) /\
    read memory t=current /\
    (MAYCHANGE [RIP;RSP;RAX] ,, MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,, MAYCHANGE [events]) s t
definitions.name: c1_tail_post

definitions.literal:
c1_tail_pre stackpointer ra result current p q n rp wp xp ordinary
    (s:x86state) <=>
    (result:int64=word 0 \/ result=word 1) /\
    16<=val(stackpointer:int64) /\ val stackpointer+8<2 EXP 64 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word 0x21001110) c1_crypto_caller_mc /\
    read RIP s=word 0x21001119 /\
    read RSP s=word_sub stackpointer (word 8) /\ read RAX s=result /\
    read memory s=current /\ read(memory :> bytes64 stackpointer)s=ra /\
    assurance_span_ok (c1_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n)
      (val stackpointer) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (c1_allowed_fetch xp ordinary) 0x21001110 22
definitions.name: c1_tail_pre

definitions.literal: cw_execute a <=> lw_execute a \/ c1_image_execute a
definitions.name: cw_execute

definitions.literal: cw_external a <=> 0x50000000 <= a /\ assurance_canonical48 a
definitions.name: cw_external

definitions.literal:
cw_layout (p:int64) (q:int64) n k different <=>
    n<2 EXP 64 /\ assurance_span_ok cw_external (val p) n /\
    assurance_span_ok cw_external (val q) n /\
    (different ==> k<n /\
      !i. i<n ==> ~(word_add q (word i)=word_add p (word k)))
definitions.name: cw_layout

definitions.literal:
cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different =
    write (bytes64 (word 0x300008)) (word 0x400000)
      (write (bytes64 (word 0x21003fd8)) (word 0x10241840)
        (cw_seed lib_file client_file p k different))
definitions.name: cw_memory

definitions.literal: cw_ordinary a <=> assurance_canonical48 a
definitions.name: cw_ordinary

definitions.literal: cw_read a <=> assurance_canonical48 a /\ ~(a=0)
definitions.name: cw_read
cw_seed

definitions.literal:
cw_state lib_file client_file p q n k different =
    x86state_RECORD (word 0x21001110)
      (\j:(4)word. if j=word 7 then p else if j=word 6 then q
                    else if j=word 2 then word n
                    else if j=word 4 then word 0x300008 else word 0)
      (\j:(5)word. word 0) (\j:(3)word. word 0) (word 2)
      (cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different) []
definitions.name: cw_state

definitions.literal:
cw_write a <=>
    if lw_image_domain a then lw_image_write a
    else if c1_image_domain a then c1_image_write a
    else assurance_canonical48 a
definitions.name: cw_write

objects.literal:
!lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
    c1_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
      stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (s,a)
    ==> assurance_checked_run (c1_steps n)
      (c1_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m s)
      (c1_step_policy stackpointer p q n rp wp xp ordinary) s
objects.name: C1_CRYPTO_CALLER_CHECKED

objects.literal:
!n. c1_steps n = 8 +
    (if n=0 then 6 else if n=16 then 15 else 7*n+10)
objects.name: C1_CRYPTO_CALLER_COUNT

objects.literal:
!lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
    c1_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
      stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (s,a)
    ==> assurance_checked_run 3
      (c1_crypto_ready lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp xp ordinary s a)
      (c1_segment_policy stackpointer p q n rp wp xp ordinary) s
objects.name: C1_CRYPTO_HANDOFF

objects.literal:
!lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
    c1_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
      stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (s,a)
    ==> eventually_n abi_caller_scalar_extended_step (c1_steps n)
      (c1_public_post stackpointer ra p q n m s a) (s,a)
objects.name: C1_CRYPTO_CALLER_INTERFACE

objects.literal:
!lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
    c1_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
      stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (s,a)
    ==> assurance_checked_run (c1_steps n)
      (\t. c1_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m s t /\ e5_normal_flags t)
      (e5_normal_step_policy
        (c1_step_policy stackpointer p q n rp wp xp ordinary)) s
objects.name: C1_CRYPTO_CALLER_NORMAL_CHECKED

objects.literal:
!lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
    c1_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
      stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (s,a)
    ==> eventually_n e5_rf_retired_extended_step (c1_steps n)
      (\t. c1_public_post stackpointer ra p q n m s a t /\
           e5_normal_flags(FST t)) (s,a)
objects.name: C1_CRYPTO_CALLER_NORMAL_INTERFACE

objects.literal:
!lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
    c1_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
      stackpointer ra p q n m rp wp xp ordinary (s,a)
    ==> e5_rf_checked_run (c1_steps n)
      (\t. c1_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m s t /\ e5_normal_flags t)
      (e5_normal_step_policy
        (c1_step_policy stackpointer p q n rp wp xp ordinary)) s
objects.name: C1_CRYPTO_CALLER_RF_NORMAL_CHECKED

objects.literal:
!lib_file client_file. fb_file_code lib_file /\ c1_file_code client_file ==>
    c1_entry_witness lib_file client_file (word 0) (word 0) 0 0 F /\
    c1_entry_witness lib_file client_file
      (word 0x50000000) (word 0x60000000) 1 0 F /\
    c1_entry_witness lib_file client_file
      (word 0x50000003) (word 0x60000005) 17 0 T /\
    c1_entry_witness lib_file client_file
      (word 0x50000003) (word 0x50000003) 16 0 F /\
    c1_entry_witness lib_file client_file
      (word 0x50000003) (word 0x50000004) 17 0 F /\
    c1_entry_witness lib_file client_file
      (word 0x50000fff) (word 0x60000fff) 15 14 T /\
    c1_entry_witness lib_file client_file
      (word 0x7fffffffffff) (word 0xffff800000000000) 1 0 T
objects.name: C1_ADMISSIBLE_ENTRY_WITNESSES

objects.literal:
!lib_file client_file p q n k different. cw_layout p q n k different ==>
    (!i. i<n ==> cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different
      (word_add p (word i))=(if different /\ i=k then word 255 else word 128)) /\
    (!i. i<n ==> cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different
      (word_add q (word i))=word 128)
objects.name: CW_BUFFER_VALUES

objects.literal:
!(s:x86state) (pc:int64) l.
    (!i. i<LENGTH l ==> read memory s (word_add pc (word i))=EL i l)
    ==> bytes_loaded s pc l
objects.name: CW_BYTES_LOADED_READS

objects.literal: !addr. cw_external addr ==> cw_read addr /\ cw_write addr /\ cw_ordinary addr
objects.name: CW_EXTERNAL_PERMISSIONS

objects.literal:
!(addr:int64). cw_external(val addr) ==>
    ~fb_immutable(val addr) /\ ~c1_immutable(val addr) /\
    ~assurance_region (word 0x300008) 8 (val addr) /\
    ~assurance_region (word 0x21003fd8) 8 (val addr)
objects.name: CW_EXTERNAL_POINT

objects.literal:
assurance_span_ok (\a. cw_read a /\ cw_ordinary a) (0x300008-16) 8 /\
  assurance_span_ok (\a. cw_write a /\ cw_ordinary a) (0x300008-16) 8 /\
  assurance_span_ok (\a. cw_read a /\ cw_ordinary a) 0x300008 8 /\
  assurance_span_ok (\a. cw_read a /\ cw_ordinary a) 0x21003fd8 8 /\
  assurance_span_ok (\a. cw_execute a /\ cw_ordinary a) 0x21001110 22 /\
  assurance_span_ok (\a. cw_execute a /\ cw_ordinary a) 0x21001030 6 /\
  assurance_span_ok (\a. cw_execute a /\ cw_ordinary a) 0x10241840 95
objects.name: CW_FIXED_SPANS

objects.literal:
!lib_file client_file p q n k different.
    fb_file_code lib_file /\ c1_file_code client_file /\ cw_layout p q n k different
    ==> c1_entry_witness lib_file client_file p q n k different
objects.name: CW_GENERIC_WITNESS

objects.literal:
(!addr. lw_image_domain addr ==> cw_read addr /\ cw_ordinary addr /\
    (cw_execute addr <=> lw_execute addr) /\
    (cw_write addr <=> lw_image_write addr)) /\
  (!addr. c1_image_domain addr ==> cw_read addr /\ cw_ordinary addr /\
    (cw_execute addr <=> c1_image_execute addr) /\
    (cw_write addr <=> c1_image_write addr))
objects.name: CW_IMAGE_PERMISSIONS

objects.literal:
!(p:int64) n i. n<2 EXP 64 /\ val p+n<=2 EXP 64 /\ i<n
    ==> val(word_add p (word i))=val p+i

objects.literal: assurance_canonical48(val(read ABI_FS_BASE fb_initial_abi))
objects.name: CW_INITIAL_ABI

objects.literal:
!p q n k different. cw_layout p q n k different ==>
    assurance_span_ok (\a. cw_read a /\ cw_ordinary a) (val p) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. cw_read a /\ cw_ordinary a) (val q) n /\
    (!addr. ~(assurance_region p n addr /\ c1_call_slot(word 0x300008) addr)) /\
    (!addr. ~(assurance_region q n addr /\ c1_call_slot(word 0x300008) addr))

objects.literal:
!p q n k different i. cw_layout p q n k different /\ i<n ==>

    cw_external(val(word_add q (word i)))
objects.name: CW_LAYOUT_POINT

objects.literal:
!lib_file client_file p q n k different.
    fb_file_code lib_file /\ c1_file_code client_file
    ==> c1_loaded_code(cw_state lib_file client_file p q n k different)

objects.literal:
!lib_file client_file p k different.
    fb_full_image lib_file (cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different)
      (cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different)
      (cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different) /\
    c1_full_image client_file (cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different)
      (cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different)
      (cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different)

objects.literal:
!lib_file client_file p k different (addr:int64).
    (fb_immutable(val addr) ==> cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different addr=
      lib_file(val addr-0x10000000)) /\
    (c1_immutable(val addr) ==> cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different addr=
      client_file(val addr-0x21000000))

objects.literal:
!lib_file client_file p k different (addr:int64).
    ~assurance_region (word 0x300008) 8 (val addr) /\
    ~assurance_region (word 0x21003fd8) 8 (val addr)
    ==> cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different addr=
        cw_seed lib_file client_file p k different addr

objects.literal:
!lib_file client_file p k different.
    read (bytes64 (word 0x300008))
      (cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different)=word 0x400000 /\
    read (bytes64 (word 0x21003fd8))
      (cw_memory lib_file client_file p k different)=word 0x10241840
objects.name: CW_MEMORY_WORDS

objects.literal:
!lib_file client_file p q n k different.
    fb_file_code lib_file /\ c1_file_code client_file /\ cw_layout p q n k different
